BUSINESS STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #13
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: BUSINESS STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Replace the compass rose
   B. Explain symbols used on a map
   C. Measure rainfall only
   D. Name the president

2. Which statement about Statement of Financial Position is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Statement of Financial Position.
   B. Treat Statement of Financial Position as rumours only.
   C. Explain Statement of Financial Position with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Statement of Financial Position never happens in Kenya.

3. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Kisumu
   B. Nairobi
   C. Nakuru
   D. Mombasa

4. Which statement about Networking in Business is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Networking in Business as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Networking in Business.
   C. Explain Networking in Business with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Networking in Business never happens in Kenya.

5. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Plan income and spending wisely
   B. Avoid saving forever
   C. Ignore prices in shops
   D. Hide all money underground

6. Which statement about Insurance is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Insurance as rumours only.
   B. Explain Insurance with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Insurance never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Insurance.

7. Which statement about Money Markets is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Money Markets never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Money Markets as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Money Markets.
   D. Explain Money Markets with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

8. Which statement about Public Finance is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Public Finance never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Public Finance as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Public Finance.
   D. Explain Public Finance with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

9. Which statement about Entrepreneurship is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Entrepreneurship never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Entrepreneurship with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Entrepreneurship as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Entrepreneurship.

10. Which statement about End - Of - Year Adjustments is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain End - Of - Year Adjustments with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say End - Of - Year Adjustments never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat End - Of - Year Adjustments as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing End - Of - Year Adjustments.

11. Which statement about Types of Business Ownership is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Types of Business Ownership never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Types of Business Ownership.
   C. Treat Types of Business Ownership as rumours only.
   D. Explain Types of Business Ownership with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

12. Which statement about Marketing is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Marketing with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Marketing.
   C. Say Marketing never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Marketing as rumours only.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Inflation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Economic Integration and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain National Income and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Types of Business Ownership and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
